title: Weak and strong βη-normalization in pure type systems with βη-conversion
abstract: A Lean formalization of the Barendregt-Geuvers-Klop conjecture, "weak normalization implies strong normalization", for the pure type systems PTS_βη of Geuvers (Logics and Type Systems, 1993), whose conversion rule uses βη-conversion. For every PTS specification, with no functionality assumption, it proves two theorems about the legal terms of PTS_βη. If every legal term is weakly βη-normalizing, then every legal term is strongly βη-normalizing. If every legal term is weakly β-normalizing, then every legal term is strongly βη-normalizing. The proof adapts OpenAI's 2026 proof of the β case for PTS_β, whose Lean files are included. An η-step can delete a λ-annotation, so the proof works from a weaker hypothesis, that every legal term has a β-reduct with no β-redex outside its λ-domains. Conversion is handled through domain erasure, candidates are indexed by βη-normal forms of erased types, and observation values are made η-canonical.
